fields.statement: QA at 27088b322 with a scratch build (go build -o $TMPDIR/rhiza-qa ./cmd/rhiza), rhiza run start --foreground on a wait step (timeout 2s, interval 1s, condition logs each check, never holds): with RHIZA_TEST_CLOCK_SCALE unset, empty, abc, 0, -5 and 1.5 each timed out 'did not hold within 2s' after exactly 3 checks in 2.06-2.09 s wall (RealClock, unchanged); at 1000, 40 checks in 2.11 s. At 1000: a 10m/30s wait whose condition holds after 1 s of real time passed after 18 checks in 1.10 s; a never-holding 10m/30s and 2m/30s wait timed out in 3.09/3.16 s (3 s real floor); a 100ms/30ms wait took 5 checks and 0.17 s on both clocks (sleeps under 50 ms unscaled). go test -count=1 -race ./internal/run -run 'TestScaledClock|TestTimedOut|TestWait|TestClock' ok.

QA at 27088b322 with the scratch build: rhiza ship deploy against a refused deploy URL (rhiza.ship.deployTimeout 3s, RHIZA_DEPLOY_INTERVAL=1s) reported 'after 3 polls over 3s' in 2.12 s wall with the scale unset and 2.11 s with abc (timing unchanged), and the same 3 polls in 0.21 s at scale 1000 (deadline on the clock it sleeps on). go test -count=1 -p 2 ./internal/api -run 'TestRunClock|TestTypePointer|TestShipDeploy|TestSpawnSleep|TestRetry|TestSessionMessage|TestRun' ok in 10.9 s.

QA at 27088b322: go test -count=1 -p 2 -v ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(run-ship-conflict-fix|run-ship-conflict-fix-more|run-ship-ci-fix|run-ship-main-dispatch-fail|arbiter-agent-tabs|plan-workflow-ci-infra-wait|session-message-busy|wait-timeout)$' all PASS together: conflict-fix 25.3 s, conflict-fix-more 29.3 s, ci-fix 25.8, main-dispatch-fail 7.0, arbiter-agent-tabs 3.5, plan-workflow-ci-infra-wait 7.0, session-message-busy 0.6, wait-timeout 4.4. The split's two scripts hold the same 94 distinct exec/stdout/stderr/exists lines as the old run-ship-conflict-fix. By hand with the built binary, the wait-timeout workflow gives 3 checks on RealClock and 40 at scale 1000.
